title: Lab query workbook
objective: A realistic query combines joins, tenant/user boundaries, filtering, grouping, and deterministic output, then proves both expected rows and excluded rows.
misconception: The starter counts finished work and includes disabled users or other tenants in the owner report.
acceptance: Trace cardinality from users to projects to tasks. Consider a user with no projects, a project with no tasks, a NULL estimate and a task in another tenant. Verify empty groups and security exclusions in addition to happy-path totals.
securityBoundary: JOIN and GROUP BY can produce plausible counts while still double-counting rows, dropping empty groups or leaking tenant data.
